description: This file defines the IfTokenParser class in the Twig templating engine. It handles parsing the 'if' tag in Twig templates, managing conditional statements, and generating corresponding syntax tree nodes.

classes.name: IfTokenParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing the 'if' tags in Twig templates, constructing an IfNode representing the conditional logic.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'if' tag and its associated conditions, else, and endif blocks, returning an IfNode object.

methods.name: decideIfFork
methods.description: Determines if the current token indicates an 'elseif', 'else', or 'endif' to decide control flow in parsing.

methods.name: decideIfEnd
methods.description: Checks if the current token indicates the end of the 'if' block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with this token parser, which is 'if'.
